confidence_notes: The RBA rate comes from a search result summary of the RBA pages, not from a page I opened. Food and drink anchors come from crowdsourced Tottori figures (Citycost, Almurakib) and Japan-wide Numbeo figures. Those sources disagree somewhat. Cocktail and wine-by-the-glass prices were not found directly. I set them relative to beer and general Japanese izakaya prices, at about ¥700 for a cocktail and about ¥800 for a glass of wine. Accommodation anchors are holistic estimates from general knowledge, not from live listings. Tottori is a small regional city with few hostels, so the hostel figures are especially uncertain.
comparable_city_reasoning: Based on Tottori crowdsourced price data, cross-checked with Japan-wide Numbeo averages and small regional Japanese cities such as Matsue and Fukuoka. Accommodation is compared with other San'in regional cities.
